test_scenarios.scenario_name: Happy Path: Full Audit with Excellent Quality
test_scenarios.description: All 5 categories present, high confidence scores (>=70), multi-source confirmation (>2 sources), valid severity values, complete escalation history. Should yield Grade A (90+).

database_state.event_summary: 15 events across all 5 categories with excellent quality metrics

success_criteria: All 5 categories covered (geopolitical, health, regulatory, macro, tech)
Recommendations array empty or <=2 minor suggestions
validation_rules: Verify breakdown totals: category_score + confidence_score + source_score + severity_score + escalation_score = data_quality_score
Verify grade assignment: A means 90-100 score
Verify category_coverage object: all 5 keys true
Verify no duplicate risk_ids in issue arrays

test_scenarios.scenario_name: Edge Case: Partial Coverage with Low Confidence
test_scenarios.description: Only 3/5 categories (missing regulatory, tech). Confidence 40-70 range. Multiple single-source events. Missing escalation history. Should yield Grade D (60-69).

database_state.event_summary: 10 events across 3 categories with quality gaps

validation_rules: Verify all missing_escalation_history are narrative risk_type
Verify recommendations include category gaps and confidence issues

error_scenarios.description: User provides date in wrong format (MM/DD/YYYY instead of YYYY-MM-DD).
success_criteria: error_details mentions actual format or input
No partial audit data in response
validation_rules: Verify recovery_suggestions is array of strings (length >= 1)
Verify no audit_date, data_quality_score, or breakdown fields

error_scenarios.description: Database is unavailable, connection times out, or credentials invalid.
success_criteria: error_details may mention 'timeout' or specific error
recovery_suggestions includes credentials or hostname check
validation_rules: Verify recovery_suggestions each are non-empty strings
Verify no events_audited, data_quality_score, or breakdown

error_scenarios.scenario_name: Error Handling: No Events (Valid Empty State, NOT Failure)
error_scenarios.description: Valid date but no events in database (weekend, holiday, or future date). Query succeeds but returns 0 rows. Should return SUCCESS with 0 events, zero scores, grade F - this is VALID, not an error.
success_criteria: Status is SUCCESS (NOT FAILURE - empty data is valid)
Recommendations mention no events collected or day has no data
validation_rules: Verify all category_coverage booleans are false

happy_path.purpose: Verify agent produces Grade A audit with all dimensions optimized
happy_path.setup: Mock database with 15 events covering all 5 categories, high confidence, multi-source, valid severity
happy_path.assertions: Score >= 90, grade = A, all issue arrays empty, recommendations minimal

edge_case.purpose: Verify agent correctly identifies and scores partial coverage scenarios
edge_case.setup: Mock database with 10 events, only 3 categories, low confidence scores, single-source events
edge_case.assertions: Score 60-69, grade = D, specific issues flagged, actionable recommendations

error_invalid_date.purpose: Verify agent validates input date format strictly
error_invalid_date.assertions: FAILURE status, invalid_date category, format guidance in recovery

error_connection.purpose: Verify agent handles database unavailability gracefully
error_connection.assertions: FAILURE status, connection_failure category, recovery suggestions

error_empty_result.purpose: Verify agent distinguishes between 'no data' (valid) vs 'connection error' (failure)
error_empty_result.assertions: SUCCESS status, data_quality_score = 0, grade = F, all dimensions = 0

implementation_notes.execution_mode: Should test against database mock or fixture
implementation_notes.happy_path_notes: Requires realistic data with all 5 categories and high-quality metrics
implementation_notes.edge_case_notes: Tests partial coverage detection and scoring proportionality
implementation_notes.error_handling_notes: Tests both FAILURE responses (connection, format) and valid empty states
